title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Process Description and Academic Stage Re-test
prompt: In many universities, students are required to complete a foundation year before starting their main degree, and some institutions also require a re-test of academic skills at the end of the first year. Some educators argue that these additional stages improve preparedness, while others believe they delay progress and increase stress. Discuss both views and give your own opinion on whether such additional academic stages should be mandatory. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请针对题目要求，讨论双方观点并给出自己的立场，建议至少250词。注意：不要只描述流程或数据，要明确表达并支持你的观点。
